correctness.rationale: The free pair-model products concatenate underlying nonempty words. For an idempotent substitution, equality of the nonerasing projected word with its twice-substituted image forces each letter present in an image to have singleton image, necessarily itself. All remaining generator images lie in the free subalgebra on fixed letters, which the endomorphism fixes pointwise. This is an if-and-only-if classification. Each length-j image over s letters has 2^(j-1)s^j controls, yielding binomial(n,s) H_s(L)^(n-s) exactly. Finite exponential maximization, strict concavity of (n-s)log(2s), the Lambert W critical equation and the explicit n=3 tie prove the remaining statements, with the L-then-n limiting order respected. n=1 boundary identity holds.
